question: How does equal seeing arise in yoga?
premises: the self abiding in all beings is seen
all beings are seen in the self
equal seeing arises and yoga follows
inference: contemplating self as knower unifies beings and produces equal seeing
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms retained as given
plain_english: The yoga-united self sees the self abiding in all beings and all beings in the self; contemplating the self entering as knower unifies all beings, so equal seeing arises.
